advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a canned unit test asserting OverlapVerdictEntry (via overlap_verdict_batch_response_model) marks candidate_id/relation/confidence/abstain as required and leaves shared_artifact optional.
evidence: contracts.py:211-220 states the four fields are REQUIRED here 'unlike on the single-pair parent … with every field optional the model omitted confidence, which defaulted to 0.0 and so could never clear overlap_conf_threshold'

search of tests for 'OverlapVerdictEntry', 'overlap_verdict_batch', 'overlap_verdict_batch_response_model', and 'model_json_schema' returns no assertion on the batch entry model's required set (only unrelated models e.g. tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_happy.py:27 assert BridgeFsckOut ...['required'])

Precedent that this class of contract IS canned-assertable: tests/interfaces/contracts/test_public_types.py:38 'assert cls.__required_keys__ == required' and tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_heldout.py:61 uses 'f.is_required()' against the schema-required set

ABSENCE: re-adding default= to any of the four fields (a direct revert of this fix) would silently drop it from the schema `required` array with no failing test; only scripts/overlap_judge_calibrate.py (a live Bedrock script, grep shows it is referenced only in docs and a source comment, not in CI) would catch it
advisory.finding: The contract fix at the heart of this change — making candidate_id/relation/confidence/abstain REQUIRED on OverlapVerdictEntry so the emitted batch JSON Schema carries a `required` array — has no canned unit test asserting the schema's required/optional field split. The required-array is a deterministic, statically-assertable artifact (unlike the model's generation behavior), and the repo already asserts such splits elsewhere. The only guard is the manually-run live probe scripts/overlap_judge_calibrate.py, which is not wired into CI or any test target.
scenarios: A future refactor re-introduces default= (or default_factory) on relation/confidence/abstain, reverting to the all-optional shape that produced zero findings across 2,093 reviews
A pydantic/base-model change causes the subclass to inherit the parent's defaults again, silently un-requiring the fields
advisory.suggested_fix: Add to tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py a test that builds the model and asserts the required set, e.g.: `from rebar.llm.contracts import overlap_verdict_batch_response_model; Entry = overlap_verdict_batch_response_model().model_fields['verdicts'].annotation.__args__[0]; req = {n for n,f in Entry.model_fields.items() if f.is_required()}; assert req == {'candidate_id','relation','confidence','abstain'}; assert not Entry.model_fields['shared_artifact'].is_required()`.
